title: PM Modi extends Diwali wishes, says will celebrate festival with soldiers
description:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday conveyed his Diwali greetings to the nation, saying that, like in previous years, he will celebrate the festival with the brave soldiers of the country.
In a video message posted on his social media handles, Modi said he will celebrate the festival with great enthusiasm.
He also said the whole country was being illuminated with lights on the eve of Deepavali, and added that it reflects the country's resolve against darkness.
"My heartiest greetings to all of you for Diwali. I wish for peace, prosperity and happiness for all of you in the coming days. I also celebrate Deepavali like you with great enthusiasm," he said.
The prime minister said he has been celebrating Diwali with the brave soldiers of the country every year.
"This time also, I will continue the tradition," he said, adding, "Have a great Diwali".
He, however, did not disclose at which military station or post he will celebrate the festival.
